name: Ironway
description: Direct-to-consumer watch brand selling the Field Watch 41, a rugged analog field watch (sapphire crystal, Japanese quartz movement, NATO straps) aimed at outdoor, hunting, fishing and veteran audiences, marketed almost entirely through creator videos run as paid ads.

evidence.summary: Ironway's own Creator Commission Program page (fetched): creators join via Trybe, receive a free Field Watch 41 to keep, and earn 15% of every sale their video generates when Ironway runs it as a paid ad; tracking is Trybe server-side with a 7-day last-click model and payouts are automatic weekly (commission lands within 7 days). The brand says it spends six figures a month on ads and scales spend on videos reaching 1.5x ROAS or higher.

Cap verdict — UNCAPPED, in the program's own words on its own page: 'you earn 15% of every sale it generates. No flat fees. No limits.'; 'Most creator programs cap your upside at a flat fee. Ours doesn't.'; and a section headed 'Unlimited upside tied to ad spend'. This is an explicit no-earnings-limit statement in the brand's own program terms, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped.

Ironway's official Instagram account @ironway (about 15K followers) posts Field Watch 41 product content aimed at outdoor and military-style users, matching the creator demographic its program page says it recruits (men 40+, hunters, fishermen, veterans).

opportunity.compensation_notes: 15% of sales generated by the creator's video when run as an Ironway ad; explicitly uncapped ('No limits' in the program's own words); free watch shipped to creators; weekly automatic payouts via Trybe.
opportunity.description: Apply through the brand's Trybe invite on its creator program page; no follower-count requirement — the brand judges content quality and audience fit (men 40+, outdoor/tactical niches).
opportunity.title: Ironway Creator Commission Program

reasons.niche_fit: A single hero product (field watch) built for outdoor/men's lifestyle creators — a focused but real fashion-accessory niche fit.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The entire business model is creator video: the brand's own page describes scaling creator content with six-figure monthly ad spend, partnership ads from creators' own accounts, and an active creator community with weekly briefs.
reasons.compensation: Published 15% of generated sales with an explicit no-limit statement on the brand's own program page and weekly automatic payouts — top-band published terms.
reasons.contact_access: A public program page with a direct Trybe application route, but no published email or partnerships contact.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via Trybe with no minimum following; the brand reviews profiles and ships the product free.
reasons.credibility: Young, small DTC brand (about 15K Instagram followers); its six-figure ad-spend claims are self-reported and unverified.

name: Nello
description: Wellness drink-powder brand ('Superpowders') selling Supercalm (KSM-66 ashwagandha cortisol-support drink), Superfocus, Superbalance, Superglow and Supersleep through its own Shopify store on subscription.

evidence.summary: Nello's own published Creator Program Terms & Conditions (fetched): creators earn 3% of qualifying Meta ad spend attributable to their submitted content while Nello runs it as paid ads on Meta placements; payouts monthly within 30 days via Trybe (PayPal, ACH or Stripe) with a $25 minimum; participants must be 18+ with an active Trybe account and submit raw, un-watermarked 1080p+ footage.

The terms state no earnings cap, but they also state Nello makes no guarantees about the volume of ad spend or how long content runs — there is no explicit no-cap statement, so commission_cap is honestly recorded as unknown under the strict filter.

Nello's homepage (fetched) sells its Superpowder drink mixes (Supercalm with KSM-66 ashwagandha and L-theanine, Superfocus, Superbalance, Superglow, Supersleep) and states 'Find us on Instagram and TikTok @drinknello'.

opportunity.compensation_notes: 3% of qualifying Meta ad spend behind the creator's content (not a % of product sales); monthly payouts via Trybe, $25 minimum; no cap stated in the terms and no spend guaranteed, so cap is unknown.
opportunity.description: Join with an active Trybe account, submit existing or new raw footage featuring Nello products, and earn while Nello runs it as Meta ads. A separate invite-only VIP tier exists but is not the open route.
opportunity.title: Nello Creator Program (via Trybe)

reasons.niche_fit: Calm/focus/sleep drink powders are a core wellness-creator niche with highly demonstrable products.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A formal, documented creator program with full published terms, content briefs and raw-footage submission rules on the brand's own site.
reasons.compensation: Published pay exists (3%) but it is a share of ad spend rather than sales, and the brand guarantees no spend volume or duration, so real earnings are uncertain.
reasons.contact_access: Full program terms published on the brand's own site with a program contact route on the same page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to any 18+ creator with a Trybe account; a VIP tier is invite-only but the base program is an open route.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC wellness brand selling multiple formulated products with GMP-certified, third-party-tested claims on its own site.

name: Sally Beauty
description: The world's largest retailer of professional beauty supplies, operating more than 2,700 Sally Beauty stores and selling 8,000+ professional hair color, hair care, nail and beauty products to consumers and salon professionals.

evidence.summary: Affiliate-toolkit's program page (fetched) confirms Sally Beauty's affiliate program runs on CJ Affiliate ('Apply for Sally Beauty at CJ') and quotes the program's own text: 'earn up to 15% commission', 15-day cookie duration and a daily-updated product feed; the same page describes Sally Beauty as the world's largest retailer of professional beauty supplies with more than 2,700 stores and over 8,000 products.

Rate conflict, so commission_rate is null: several directories state 15% on CJ with a 15-day cookie, but others state 5% on full-price purchases and 2% on coupon-code purchases via CJ, and another lists 10%. 'Up to 15%' is a ceiling, not a settled rate, and the sources conflict, so no single rate is recorded.

opportunity.compensation_notes: Program text advertises up to 15% commission with a 15-day cookie on CJ, but directory sources conflict (15% vs 5%/2% vs 10%), so the rate is recorded as unpublished/conflicted rather than guessed.
opportunity.description: Apply to the Sally Beauty program inside CJ Affiliate; once approved you get tracking links and a daily product feed across hair color, hair care, nails and beauty.
opportunity.title: Sally Beauty Affiliate Program (CJ Affiliate)

reasons.niche_fit: Professional hair color, hair care and nails are core beauty-creator categories, and Sally is the category's biggest retailer.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running publisher affiliate program exists, but no formal creator/UGC program with briefs or community was found — evidence is affiliate-style rather than creator-style.
reasons.compensation: A published ceiling ('up to 15%') exists, but directory rates conflict (15% vs 5%/2% vs 10%), so compensation is scored on the conflicted evidence, not a settled rate.
reasons.contact_access: Application route is through CJ Affiliate and the program maintains an affiliate team on that network; no direct public creator contact was published.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through CJ Affiliate for publishers and creators.
reasons.credibility: Sally Beauty Holdings is a long-established public retailer (since 1964) with thousands of stores internationally.

name: Harry's
description: Men's grooming company founded in New York in 2013 selling razors and German-engineered blades on subscription, plus shave gel, skincare, body wash and deodorant, through harrys.com and major retailers; it reports more than 20 million customers.

evidence.summary: Harry's own affiliate program text, mirrored on affi.io (fetched): 'The Harry's affiliate program is offering £4 per Trial Set subscription sign-up and 5% on any one-off purchases', with a 30-day cookie, banners/creatives and voucher codes for approved affiliates. The £4 is a flat per-sign-up bounty; the 5% is the recorded percentage rate. The same page states Harry's was created in 2013 by founders Jeff and Andy and has been tried by over 20 million customers.

Other directories quote different figures — Lasso lists 'up to 15%' (a rate ceiling, not a rate) and Shopper lists 5.6% — so the brand's own program text (5% on purchases plus £4 flat per Trial Set sign-up) is used as the basis and the alternatives are documented here rather than blended.

A public Harry's affiliate onboarding guide includes pro tips for making high-performing TikTok content and a section on TikTok-exclusive bundles, showing the program actively recruits and coaches short-form video creators.

opportunity.compensation_notes: Per the brand's own program text: 5% commission on one-off purchases plus a flat £4 per Trial Set subscription sign-up, 30-day cookie. Directory figures of 'up to 15%' are a ceiling and were not adopted. No cap statement published, so cap is unknown.
opportunity.description: Apply to the Harry's affiliate program through its network listing; approved affiliates get banners, voucher codes and onboarding support including TikTok content guidance.
opportunity.title: Harry's Affiliate Program

reasons.niche_fit: Men's grooming and shaving is a well-defined creator niche and Harry's is one of its best-known DTC brands.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An established affiliate program plus a public onboarding guide with TikTok content coaching and TikTok-exclusive bundles show active creator recruitment, though it is affiliate-led rather than a UGC community.
reasons.compensation: Published terms from the brand's own program text: 5% on purchases plus a flat £4 per subscription sign-up, 30-day cookie.
reasons.contact_access: Joining is via the program's network listing; no public partnerships email was found on the fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with approval; creatives and voucher codes provided once approved.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2013, 20M+ customers, own German blade factory and national retail distribution — fully established brand.

name: ByltBasics
description: Premium basics apparel brand (BYLT Basics) selling tailored-fit tees, polos, shorts, athleisure and footwear made with technical fabrics, direct-to-consumer through byltbasics.com and its own retail stores.

evidence.summary: Shopper.com's program page (fetched) lists a Bylt Basics affiliate program paying 2% per sale with instant approval through Shopper; it publishes no cookie duration or underlying network detail, and it is the only source found, so the listing is recorded as needs_review.

BYLT Basics operates its own retail stores (e.g., Fashion Island, Newport Beach, CA) selling premium apparel, footwear and accessories; its separate BYLT+ customer rewards program pays store credit and was NOT used as the qualifying route (store-credit schemes are excluded) — inclusion rests on the Shopper-listed affiliate program.

opportunity.compensation_notes: 2% per sale per a single directory listing (Shopper.com), flagged needs_review; no cap statement published, so cap is unknown. The brand's BYLT+ rewards pay store credit and are not an affiliate route.
opportunity.description: Partner through the Shopper.com listing for Bylt Basics and promote its premium basics with tracking links; verify current terms inside Shopper before creating content, as this is a single-source listing.
opportunity.title: Bylt Basics Affiliate Program (Shopper.com listing)

reasons.niche_fit: Premium men's basics and athleisure are a strong, content-friendly fashion niche with a loyal DTC following.
reasons.ugc_evidence: No formal creator or ambassador program could be verified on the brand's own site; evidence is a single third-party affiliate listing.
reasons.compensation: Only one source publishes a rate (2% per sale) and it is low and unverified against the brand's own pages, so compensation stays low.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator application page or partnerships contact was found on the brand's own site; the only route is the Shopper listing.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Shopper advertises instant approval, but with a single unverified listing the real availability is uncertain.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC apparel brand with physical retail stores and national e-commerce presence.

name: Tu Clothing

evidence.summary: TikTok's official Tu Clothing case study (fetched): 'By activating the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program, they initially empowered 30 creators to produce authentic, engaging video content... which resulted in over 200 creators producing branded content' for its Christmas pyjama launch, achieving a 92% sell-through rate in one week. This verifies Tu sells through TikTok Shop's affiliate program; per-product commission rates are set inside TikTok Shop and not published, so the rate is null.

Sovrn/VigLink's merchant listing for Sainsbury's Tu Clothing (tuclothing.sainsburys.co.uk) shows the program approval status as 'Open' and describes Tu as part of the Sainsbury's group and the 10th largest clothing retailer in the UK by value, located in 400 Sainsbury's stores.

Saturation note: the case study's 'over 200 creators' is a few-hundred figure, which under the directory's strict filter (a few hundred = unknown, per precedent) does not qualify as low saturation, so creator_saturation is recorded as unknown.

opportunity.compensation_notes: Commission is set per product inside TikTok Shop's affiliate system and is not published publicly; no cap statement exists, so rate is null and cap is unknown.
opportunity.description: Add Tu Clothing products to your TikTok Shop (UK) showcase and earn the per-product commission shown in TikTok Shop; TikTok documents Tu actively scaling affiliate creators (30 at launch to 200+).
opportunity.title: Tu Clothing TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

reasons.niche_fit: Mainstream fashion (including the pyjama/seasonal ranges TikTok documents selling out) is a core creator category, and Tu is a top-10 UK clothing retailer.
reasons.ugc_evidence: TikTok's own case study documents Tu running its affiliate program at scale — 30 launch creators growing to over 200 producing branded content with a 92% sell-through.
reasons.compensation: No commission rate is published anywhere fetched; TikTok Shop rates are per-product and only visible inside the platform, so compensation scores low on evidence.
reasons.contact_access: The route is inside TikTok Shop's affiliate system; no public creator contact or application page was found on the brand's own site.
reasons.opportunity_availability: TikTok Shop affiliate activation is documented and the brand demonstrably onboards creators, though UK creators need TikTok Shop affiliate access.
reasons.credibility: Tu is Sainsbury's clothing brand — one of the UK's largest retailers — with around 400 in-store locations.

name: The Motion Books
description: Maker of video books — premium physical books with a built-in screen that play your own videos — sold as wedding, memorial and family gifts through themotionbooks.com, Amazon and Etsy, and heavily promoted through TikTok Shop and affiliate creators.

evidence.summary: The Motion Books' own affiliate program page (fetched): 'Join our affiliate program and earn 15% on every purchase you refer!' — affiliates get a dashboard, custom tracking links and monthly payouts via PayPal; the page's Q&A repeats 'You will earn 15% of each sale that is made using your referral link' and cites a 13% conversion rate for affiliate traffic.

Rate conflict on the brand's own site, so commission_rate is null: the affiliate program page states 15%, but the brand's business-partnership FAQ states 'You will earn 5% of each sale that is made using your referral link' for its affiliate partnership. Both are the brand's own words describing referral-link earnings, so no single rate is recorded.

The brand's affiliate page showcases named working affiliates (wedding/event creators with their follower counts) and states the brand has over 48K Instagram followers, 145K+ TikTok followers and 20M+ social video views; TikTok's own case study for the brand (cited in the lead research) credits affiliate creators with a 13,111% increase in affiliate GMV.

opportunity.compensation_notes: The brand's own pages conflict — 15% on its affiliate program page vs 5% in its business-partnership FAQ — so the rate is recorded as null with the conflict documented; payouts are monthly via PayPal per the affiliate page. No cap statement, so cap is unknown.
opportunity.description: Sign up for the brand's own affiliate program on themotionbooks.com, get a referral link and dashboard, and promote the video books to wedding, family and gifting audiences.
opportunity.title: The Motion Books Affiliate Program

reasons.niche_fit: A single viral gift product (video books for weddings and family moments) — narrower than a full lifestyle range but very demonstrable on video.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs its own affiliate program, showcases working creator affiliates on the program page, and TikTok credits affiliate creators with outsized GMV growth for the brand.
reasons.compensation: Pay terms are published on the brand's own site but conflict (15% vs 5%), so compensation is scored down and the rate is left null.
reasons.contact_access: A public affiliate page with sign-up and dashboard on the brand's own domain.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open self-serve sign-up on the brand's own affiliate page.
reasons.credibility: Small independent brand (The Motion Books LLC) with strong marketplace ratings (4.5 stars on Amazon, 4.9 on Etsy) but limited scale.
